description: Siebly publishes documentation, machine-readable indexes, and open-source package guidance for Node.js/JavaScript/TypeScript SDKs that integrate with third-party cryptocurrency exchanges. It is not itself an exchange or API provider; the documented SDKs target other domains.
summary: siebly.io exposes public AI-agent discovery artifacts (llms.txt, agent-skills index/skill, SDK catalog, recipes/integration kits/conformance files) and documentation for SDKs, but no documented HTTP API, GraphQL API, MCP connect endpoint, or CLI whose requests target siebly.io itself.
